Container.Name: platter-bridge
Container.Overview: Optional home side for Platter, the desktop music player for Plex. At night it transcribes lyrics for songs that have none, on the server, and every device gets them, so your computer never does that heavy work (mount your music folder for this; read-only is enough). While no computer has Platter open, it also catches up with Lidarr: it scans just the folders of new downloads, keeps protected albums out of Lidarr's way and, with the music folder mounted read-write, adds new protected albums the way Platter would. Platter works fully without it. It opens no ports and talks to Platter only through a sealed relay. Start it, then open plex.tv/link and enter the code from its log, signed in to the Plex account that owns your server. Every Platter on that account finds it by itself.
Container.Requires: Platter on a computer or phone, signed in as the owner of your Plex server.

Config.Name: Lidarr address
Config.Description: Optional. Lidarr's address as the server reaches it, like http://10.20.30.40:8686. Set it and the key below and the Bridge works before any computer has shared them; it uses these over what a computer sends.

Config.Name: Lidarr API key
Config.Description: Optional, with the address: from Lidarr's Settings > General.

Config.Name: App data
Config.Description: Where the Bridge keeps its links and state.

Config.Name: Music folder
Config.Description: Your music folder, for lyrics for every song (read-only is enough; the Bridge never writes to it for lyrics). Leave it read-only and Lidarr additions wait for a computer; make it read-write (rw) and the Bridge adds new protected albums itself.

Config.Name: Plex's path for the music folder
Config.Description: Optional, with Music folder: the same folder as Plex sees it, like /data/media/Music. Leave it empty at first: the Bridge compares the folder with Plex and says in its log what to put here.

Config.Name: Lidarr staging folder
Config.Description: Optional, with a read-write music folder: Lidarr's staging folder for protected artists.

Config.Name: Staging folder inside the container
Config.Description: Leave as /staging when you set the staging folder above.

Config.Name: Plex address
Config.Description: Optional. Plex's address as the server reaches it, like http://10.20.30.40:32400. Without it the Bridge finds your server through plex.tv.

Config.Name: Plex token
Config.Description: Optional, with Plex address. Without it the Bridge signs in to Plex on its own: its log shows a code to enter at plex.tv/link.

Config.Name: Pair code
Config.Description: Not needed: the Bridge links by your Plex account. Only for a pair code from an older Platter build. Clear it after pairing.

Config.Name: Relay
Config.Description: Optional. Your own ntfy server instead of ntfy.sh (Platter must use the same one).
